name: CASINO SOUTH AFRICAN
description: South African Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in South Africa. Part of the African Casino family with face-up capture piles and opponents able to use top cards in builds. Features numerical picture card values and complex building mechanics.

content.text: South African Casino is a Royal Casino variant played in South Africa. Part of the African Casino family with face-up capture piles and opponents able to use top cards in builds. Features numerical picture card values and complex building mechanics.

South African Casino is the South Africa variant of the African Casino family, alongside Swazi Casino (Eswatini) and Sotho Casino (Lesotho). Documented by Faizal Asmal. The game represents the South African interpretation of this Royal Casino variant.
2-4 players. 4 players in fixed partnerships. Play anticlockwise.
Standard 52-card pack. Card values: 2-10=face, J=11, Q=12, K=13, A=1/14.
Similar to other African Casino variants: 4 cards cut for layout, all cards dealt to players.
